turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! How was your Wednesday at the clinic in Tucson? I hope the day-shift wasn't too exhausting today.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! It was pretty hectic, honestly. The commute wasn't too bad, though—I just hopped in my hybrid and drove myself to work today, which gave me a little quiet time before the rush started.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Glad the drive was peaceful! Did you get to use your roommate's new espresso machine to fuel up before heading out?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, I didn't have the energy to fuss with it this morning. I just brewed a simple pot of classic drip coffee and drank a cup of that instead. Nothing fancy, just standard black coffee.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sometimes a straightforward cup of coffee is exactly what you need. How did the rest of your shift go? I hope you got a proper break.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Well, the break itself was fine, but lunch was a bit of a tragedy. I actually forgot to grab the homemade burrito bowl I had prepped, so I had to make do with a random assortment of chips and snacks from the vending machine in the staff room. Definitely not my usual lunch, but it was a one-time emergency because I left my food on the counter!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh no, a vending machine lunch is always a little disappointing, especially when you have a homemade burrito bowl waiting for you at home. At least it got you through the day! Are you planning to do any sourdough baking tonight to unwind?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No baking for me tonight, I'm way too tired after that shift. I think I'll just feed my sourdough starter and leave it at that.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a very sensible plan. How have things been going with your online Italian course lately? Have you found any time to practice?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, actually! I've been doing about fifteen minutes of vocabulary practice every night. Tom even helped me review some verbs yesterday, which was fun.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's great that Tom is helping you practice! It must be nice to have a study partner. Are the two of you doing any more wedding planning for 2028 this evening, or is it strictly a rest night?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Definitely a rest night. We might just look at some photos of venues online, but mostly we're just going to relax. I'm looking forward to a quiet evening.
